CREATE TABLE refresh_token ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, token VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL UNIQUE, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT fk_refresh_token_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(user_id) );
